context.exclusions: node_modules, .git, dist, build, out, coverage, .next, .nuxt, __pycache__, .venv, venv, target, .*/, .gitignore, .graphitignore, tests/fixtures/, out-*/

provenance.facts: File pairs are static import relations extracted from source code, not observed execution.
provenance.grouping: Groups are computed by the communityMode detector; group ids are only valid for the same context.revision.
provenance.interpretation: None: labels are folder keys or detector output, not business names or responsibilities.

formulas.order: Rows and columns share one order: layer 0 first (depends on no other row), the rows of a cycle together, then by label.
formulas.cell: Cell (row, column) = distinct file pairs where a file of the row imports a file of the column; the diagonal counts the pairs inside the row.
formulas.upward: In this order every dependency sits below the diagonal; a cell above it (upward) belongs to a cycle.
formulas.instability: I = Ce / (Ca + Ce), Ce = outgoingPairs (efferent), Ca = incomingPairs (afferent), diagonal excluded; null when both are 0.
